name: Do I need to hire a professional for bathtub replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a professional for bathtub replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a professional for bathtub replacement is highly recommended. While it might seem like a DIY project, proper installation requires specialized tools, knowledge of plumbing codes, and experience in handling heavy materials. Professionals ensure correct plumbing connections to prevent leaks, proper sealing to avoid water damage, and secure placement of the tub. An incorrectly installed bathtub can lead to costly repairs down the line. A professional can also provide advice on tub selection and ensure the project meets safety standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, professional installation is recommended due to specialized tools, plumbing knowledge, and experience needed to prevent costly issues.
